label: agent loop • one wave across two different installed local worker models
query: Delegate two independent jobs in parallel: call spawn_agent twice in the SAME message (two tool calls, one message). First call: agent `A11CE001-0000-4000-8000-000000000101` (Osaurus Eval Nanbeige Worker), input: return exactly DIFFERENT_LOCAL_ALPHA. Second call: agent `A11CE001-0000-4000-8000-000000000102` (Osaurus Eval Ornith Worker), input: return exactly DIFFERENT_LOCAL_BETA. Keep that order. After both results return, answer once with both tokens and stop.
notes: Production agent-loop proof row for two explicit installed local worker models issued as one spawn_agent wave. Different local models cannot share the GPU, so the wave gate serializes them via the residency handoff and restores the orchestrator afterwards; both rows must still settle with the pinned worker model in each envelope. The two model ids are portable Hub-style ids rather than host paths. Each worker keeps nil sampler overrides so its own generation_config/JANG bundle defaults remain authoritative. Run on a host where both named bundles are installed.
